text:
lina_partnerships: Heads-up: CloudPartnerX wants a partner-ready RefKit that supports multi-cloud validation and a simple cost-estimate tool bundled with the Terraform modules. They asked for an easy 'one-folder' onboarding for their solution engineers. Can we design a minimal validator harness and cost calculator?

raj_infra: we can build a validator harness that runs `terraform init/plan` + a lightweight infra smoke deploy in a sandbox account. idea: a `validate.sh` that checks provider compatibility, module variable coverage, and performs a dry-run on each supported region. outputs a normalized JSON summary.

oliver_devx: +1. I'll sketch a repo layout that includes a `tests/` harness, `ci/` workflows, and a `tools/cost-estimator` (python). Layout:
```
refkit-cloudpartnerx/
  modules/
  examples/
  tests/
    smoke/
    integration/
  ci/
  tools/
    cost-estimator/
  docs/
```

We should standardize module inputs: `accelerator_family`, `disk_profile`, `network_zone`, `ssh_key_name`, `tag_map` (map).

marco_solutioneng: From partner side they want a Google Sheet-style cost view and an example CSV output. If `cost-estimator` can emit CSV with per-hour and monthly estimates per profile that would be perfect.

tess_security: Security notes: include guidance for KMS envelope keys, and an example `kms_key_arn` var. Also CI must not leak secrets — use `ci-bot` vault tokens. add a short section in docs/deployment-guides/security.md about least-privilege IAM.

raj_infra: POC of `tools/cost-estimator` interface: python CLI that reads a `compat.yaml` and `profiles.json` and emits CSV. sample usage: `python cost_estimator.py --profile a2-ampere --region us-west-2 --hours 720`

oliver_devx: For tests: `tests/smoke/run-smoke.sh` should use a tiny profile (1 vGPU or even faux profile using `local-exec` for no-cost validation) so partners can run locally without cloud spend. For CI runs we'll gate full cloud smoke tests behind an infra ticket.

ci-bot: CI pipeline draft created: `refkit/ci/cloudpartnerx-validator.yml`  status: draft. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/1421

lina_partnerships: Nice. Action list: 1) @oliver_devx = repo layout + module input spec + examples (due Fri); 2) @raj_infra = validator harness + `validate.sh` (due Mon); 3) @marco_solutioneng = cost CSV spec + sample CSV for partner (due Mon); 4) @tess_security = security doc stub + IAM least-privilege list (due Mon).

marco_solutioneng: also request: include a short 'compatibility matrix' in `docs/compatibility.md` mapping accelerator families to tested OS images and driver versions. helps partner SREs.

oliver_devx: I'll add `compat.yaml` and `profiles.json` with fields: `name`, `vCPU`, `memory_gb`, `gpu_model`, `os_image`, `driver_version`, `hourly_cost_estimate_usd`.

raj_infra: small implementation note: use provider aliasing so the validator can run `aws.region1`, `aws.region2` in parallel. scripts will export `TF_LOG` when running locally to help debugging.

tess_security: Also add an appendix for audit logging (cloudwatch/stackdriver sinks) and retention recommendations. Partners in regulated sectors will ask.

lina_partnerships: Good. One more ask from partner: prefer modules publishable to a private Terraform registry (module namespace + versioning). Oliver, can we include a `registry.md` with publishing instructions?

oliver_devx: yep. include `semantic_version` in root `versions.tf` and a `CHANGELOG.md` template. I'll add a sample GH Action for tagging / release workflow.

raj_infra: I'll prototype the `validate.sh` now and push a branch `refkit/partnerx/validator-v1`. will ping when PR is up.

ci-bot: Branch created: refkit/partnerx/validator-v1  PR #: 67 (https://git.internal/redwood/refkit/pull/67)

lina_partnerships: Thanks everyone. Let's try to have the partner preview by next Tue. I'll coordinate scheduling once PRs land. :rocket:
